messages.content:
Outcome: Depression cases (lower is better)

## Study A
Found: no effect
Claim: Vitamin D status was not associated with depression symptoms (CDI score of 19 or more), whether fitted continuously or categorically.
Sentence: "There was no significant association between 25(OH)D and depression symptoms whether 25(OH)D was fitted as a continuous variable (crude odds ratio (OR) 0 .99 [95%CI: 0.98, 1.01], p = 0.458 and adjusted OR 1.01 [95%CI: 0.99, 1.02], p = 0.233), categorical variable as per acceptable cut-of points (crude analysis p = 0.376 and adjusted analysis p = 0.736), or categorical variable as quartiles (crude analysis p = 0.760 and adjusted analysis p = 0.549)."
Measured as: depression symptoms (CDI score of 19 or more)
Population: 704 randomly selected adolescents in middle schools in Kuwait
Intervention: Serum 25(OH)D level (measured, not administered)
Comparator: Different vitamin D levels/status
Design: cross-sectional study
Sample size: 704
baseline_vitamin_d_status: not_reported

## Study B
Found: benefit
Claim: Vitamin D deficiency was associated with a higher risk of incident overall depression in adults with hearing impairment compared with vitamin D sufficiency.
Sentence: "For the primary outcome, VDD was associated with a significantly higher risk of overall depression (HR, 1.57; 95% CI, 1.51-1.64; P < 0.001)."
Measured as: overall depression (incident)
Population: Adults aged ≥18 with hearing impairment who had serum 25(OH)D testing (TriNetX), propensity matched
Intervention: Vitamin D deficiency (<20 ng/ml), observed exposure
Comparator: Vitamin D sufficiency (≥30 ng/ml)
Design: cohort study
Sample size: 96,368
baseline_vitamin_d_status: mixed

content.text: {"rationale":"Both are observational studies of vitamin D status and depression, but one found no association in healthy adolescents (cross-sectional, CDI symptoms) while the other found higher incident depression in adults with hearing impairment (large cohort, deficiency vs sufficiency).","verdict":"genuine","reason":"population","also_differs":["design_or_bias","outcome_measure","comparator"],"detail":"population: school adolescents in Kuwait vs adults with hearing impairment; cross-sectional symptom score vs incident depression in a matched cohort"}
